    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    No, New York City public schools are not closed today, Saturday, March 14, 2026; they are typically open on Saturdays unless it's a special event or emergency closure, and official calendars show no system-wide break, but always check official sources like schools.nyc.gov for any specific school or emergency announcements. 
    To Check for Updates:
    • Official NYC DOE Calendar: Visit the NYC Department of Education's calendar for planned holidays, like the upcoming Spring Recess in April. 
    • Local News: Check local news sites like FOX 5 NY or Spectrum News for real-time closing alerts. 
    • 311 NYC: For general city information, you can check the 311 NYC portal.

      Are there any school closings in Wisconsin today?
      An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
      AI Overview
      As of Friday, March 13, 2026, many Wisconsin schools, particularly in Northeast Wisconsin (like Sevastopol, St. John Bosco), and some central areas (like Lake Mills, Wabeno), are closed or have delays due to cold weather or power outages, while many Southeast Wisconsin districts (TMJ4, WISN, FOX6) report no current closings, but always check local news sites like WFRV, WBAY, or Channel 3000 for the most up-to-date, localized information for your specific area. 
      Where to Check for Closings: 
      • Northeast WI: WFRV (Green Bay area) & WBAY (Green Bay area).
      • Southeast WI: WISN (Milwaukee area) & FOX6 News (Milwaukee area).
      • Central WI: Channel 3000 (Madison area) & WKOW (Madison area).
      • Western WI: WEAU (Eau Claire area).
      Examples of Today's Reported Closings (March 13, 2026):
      • Sevastopol Schools & St. John Bosco Catholic School (Sturgeon Bay): (Northeast WI). 
      • Lake Mills, St. Paul Lutheran: (Central WI). 
      • Wabeno public schools, White Lake School District, Wittenberg-Birnamwood public: (Northeast/Central WI). 
      Key Takeaway: Check your local news station's weather/closings page directly, as status can vary significantly by county or even town.
